label: AppConfig and module registry
instruction: Generate modules/complaint_cms/apps.py and modules/complaint_cms/registry.py for the Complaint Management System module using the REQUIRED Fusion registry interface shown in modules/placement/registry.py. AppConfig class ComplaintCmsConfig has default_auto_field = "django.db.models.BigAutoField", name = "modules.complaint_cms", label = "complaint_cms", verbose_name = "Complaint Management System". registry.py must define MODULE plain dictionary (code "complaint_cms", label "Complaint Management System", base_path "/complaints", nav_section "Services", icon "WarningCircle", status "active", sort_order 40), NAV_ITEMS list of dictionaries for /complaints/mine (permission complaint_cms.complaint.view_self), /complaints/queue (permission complaint_cms.task.view), /complaints/admin (permission complaint_cms.configuration.manage), PERMISSIONS list of (code,label) tuples with codes complaint_cms.complaint.view_self, complaint_cms.complaint.create, complaint_cms.complaint.review, complaint_cms.complaint.resolve, complaint_cms.complaint.escalate, complaint_cms.task.view, complaint_cms.configuration.manage, complaint_cms.record.manage, ROLE_GRANTS dict mapping student/faculty/staff/Complainant, Caretaker/Warden/Unit Incharge/Section Head/Complaint Authority, and Dean/Registrar/Director/Complaint Administrator to permission lists so every declared permission has a holder, and SYSTEM_PERMISSIONS = []. Do not import views or django.urls in registry.py. Return valid JSON response.
